implementation: Build a bitmap from the original selected cell identities. Each256-thread CTA locally compacts a64x32 or128x32 tile and reuses packed original BF16 input/weight K64 slabs. Sparse tiles retain multiple independent canonical carries per subgroup. Tiles exceeding256/512 candidates execute the original four-lane replay; no candidate is dropped.

Retain original K16 ordering, complete-row eligibility, exceptional integer fallback, final BF16 conversion, unselected output ownership and caller stream. The component owns no model/output oracle and adds no product dispatch.

Launch guards validate dimensions, logical K tails, bitmap capacity, empty selections and submission errors. Generated tests compare all selected outputs with independent original CPU arithmetic and current GPU replay, preserving bitmap/redzones and immutable operands.
conclusions: All56 generated native comparisons pass, covering7 shapes and4 selection patterns for each tile size. Cases include empty,sparse,capacity/capacity+1,dense fallback,logical row/token tails,K16/64/80/272/2048/4096,eligibility edges,signed zero,subnormals and deliberately unaligned BF16 pointers.

The original prevalidated4 replay and both tiled candidates each preserve58728448 external GB10 BF16 QKV cells,3791742 original candidate identities and every raw output bit. All CPU metadata,bitmap,guard and immutability checks pass.

Completed eligibility plus bitmap/replay is49.4104/93.5343/142.6540 ms for original/64-row/128-row in one warmup and one measured sequence. Both tiled implementations regress substantially.64-row uses2015 dense fallback tiles out of28796 occupied;128-row uses1307 out of14400. Each candidate bitmap occupies7341056 bytes.

Keep both tiled candidates outside the product dispatcher. Continue structural work on the ordered K16 reduction arithmetic and reusable row metadata rather than promoting this slower operand-reuse layout.
Full make check passes365 Python tests with2 skipped,47 Rust tests,C smoke,clippy and public hygiene. Focused ASan/UBSan checks execute actual launch validation and error propagation.
limitations: This is a component numerical result, not a full model token-loop or product performance result. No q8192 product measurement was run for either slower tiled candidate.

Allocation,uploads,common candidate selection and safety-only validation lie outside the component clock. Eligibility kernels and bitmap clear/mark are included. Timing values are single observations.
Current qualified product remains FLA2ee6215 state8 at39620.1231 ms callback TTFT. Long-context,prefix,package,HTTP,soak and immutable performance/release gates remain open.
